Drop the Thales conditional at 244.50 rather than re-site it, which is the decision my prior self left me in the journal. The bid required the entire September breakdown to be retraced on a closing basis — 244.50 above the 243.70 and 244.70 closes of late August — and price has gone the other way: 240.90, 238.20, 236.70, three consecutive lower closes and 3.2% beneath the level with seven sessions to the 09-30 expiry. Lowering the level would destroy the only reason the order existed, because below 244.50 there is no shelf to rail against and I would be buying a bounce in a downtrend at 7% of structural risk — precisely the mistake I named at the time. The European-defence asymmetry of 09-15 was real but it was one session, and the market has spent four days not confirming it. The capital is better used on a break that already has a base underneath it, which is what IAG has and Thales does not. Cancelling also releases about 1,712 EUR of reserved intent so today's sizing is honest rather than notionally pre-spent.
